== Biography ==

The Prince presides over the glass city of the Mangaboos, a vegetable people living beneath the earth's crust. His subjects address him as "my Lord," and when wonders appeared in the air, the Prince and all of his people flocked out of the hall into the street to see them. He listens with attention to those who address him, as when he remarked on a visitor "from the crust of the earth" who had called a companion a Wizard.

== Relationships ==

'''[[WIZARD]]''' — acquaintance. The Prince addressed the Wizard directly and listened attentively to him, suggesting an acquaintance between the two.

'''[[DOROTHY]]''' — acquaintance. Cooccurrence in the same scenes suggests some acquaintance with Dorothy, though the excerpts do not detail the nature of this bond.

'''[[Princess]]''' — other. Cooccurrence suggests a connection with the Princess, though its nature is unclear from the available excerpts.

'''[[Sorcerer]]''' — employment. Cooccurrence during the Sorcerer's display of sorcery in the Prince's hall could indicate the Sorcerer serves under the Prince's authority.

'''[[Zeb]]''' — enemy. Cooccurrence suggests some tension with Zeb, though the excerpts do not clarify the nature of this bond.
